select
from shipping_template st
st.is_deleted = false
and st.name iLIKE concat('%',#{params.name}::text,'%')
and st.disabled = #{params.disabled}
and st.effective_date >= #{params.effectiveDateList[0]} and (#{params.effectiveDateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > st.effective_date
and st.expire_date >= #{params.expireDateList[0]} and (#{params.expireDateList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > st.expire_date
and st.create_user_id in
#{item}
and st.create_time >= #{params.createTimeList[0]} and (#{params.createTimeList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > st.create_time
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
st.id desc
